note: Derived by assistant/automation/inventory.mjs from data/07367c34/catalog-units.json, the pinned source (git object reads only) and the saved record files. Do not edit by hand; regenerate. Coverage compares unit lists only: it says an existing record covers a unit, not that the record is correct or independently reviewed (see review-status.json).

global.note: catalog skills are bare-instance values; 16 source file(s) in app/core and app/models assign a skill at run time (app/core/abilities/abilities.ts, app/core/abilities/entrainment.ts, app/core/abilities/shadow-force.ts, app/core/abilities/shields-down.ts, app/core/abilities/shields-up.ts, app/core/abilities/transe.ts, app/core/abilities/transform.ts, app/core/abilities/trick-or-treat.ts, app/core/abilities/unbound.ts, app/core/bot.ts, app/core/effects/items.ts, app/core/effects/passives.ts, app/core/evolution-logic/evolution-handler.ts, app/core/pokemon-entity.ts, app/models/colyseus-models/player.ts, app/models/colyseus-models/pokemon.ts), so a unit's cast ability can differ from its catalog skill

changePassive( is called from app/core/abilities/transe.ts, app/core/abilities/transform.ts, app/core/effects/passives.ts, app/core/pokemon-entity.ts; a unit's passive can differ from its catalog passive

implementation groups are derived from registry/class/PassiveEffects text, not from behavioural equivalence; a shared class does not prove identical behaviour for every unit (stars, stats and passives differ)

abilityFamilies.note: abilities whose strategy classes share a base class other than AbilityStrategy (the base is analysed once, subclasses reuse it); a family is a syntactic grouping, not proof of identical behaviour
